title: [AUG-190] Split Online text (Groq) into "Fix live lines" and "Collect live action items" sub-checkboxes
why_we_need_this: Rodion (Feature Request 5, @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md) wants live transcript corrections without live action items. Today one gate, groqTextState().enabled, starts both LiveTextCorrector and LiveActionItemsExtractor at connect (@server/src/services/liveTranscription.ts:172-200), so no setting separates them. This was verified in research AUG-173. Option A was chosen on the mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-173/transcription-settings.html: keep the one Groq toggle and its consent as the master, and add two child checkboxes.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Two new client preferences, groqLiveCorrection and groqLiveActionItems (boolean, default true; absent = true), are in ALLOWED_KEYS (@server/src/routes/preferences.ts) and coerced to strict booleans. They are also in UserPreferences and DEFAULT_PREFERENCES (@client/src/services/preferences.ts).
- [ ] liveTranscription.ts starts LiveTextCorrector only when the Groq text gate is active AND groqLiveCorrection !== false. It starts LiveActionItemsExtractor (including the AUG-168 local fallback) only when the gate is active AND groqLiveActionItems !== false. The 'action-items' frame field `enabled` reflects the action-items decision.
- [ ] Settings → Transcription: the master row is relabelled "Online text (Groq)" with the hint "Sends transcript text to Groq's free tier. Choose what it does:". Under it, two indented checkboxes appear, laid out as in the mockup: "Fix live lines" and "Collect live action items", each with the mockup's hint. While the master is off they are disabled and keep their saved values. With the master on and both children off, the warn hint "Live features off. Only fixes after recording use Groq." is shown.
- [ ] The consent flow is unchanged: turning the master on still opens GroqTextConsentModal, POST /api/groq-text/enable|disable still own groqTextEnabled/groqTextConsent, and turning the master off revokes consent. Batch corrections (resolveCorrectionEngine, 'Fixes after recording by') behave exactly as before.
- [ ] Users who already have Online text on see the same behaviour after the update (both children on) with no migration step.
- [ ] ActionItemsPanel hint: when Groq is on but live action items are off, the hint tells the user to turn on "Collect live action items" in Settings → Transcription (not the master); the compact text reads "Live items off — only manual items".
- [ ] Verified manually on one live recording for each combination (fix only / items only / both / master off) via server log: [actionItems] lines appear only when items are on, and correction frames appear only when fixes are on. `npm run build` and existing tests pass.
important_constraints:
Keep the Groq consent rules intact (AUG-164): text reaches Groq only with groqTextEnabled + matching key fingerprint. The new preferences never bypass consent. Prefs are read once per live connection, so a change applies to the next Live start; that is acceptable. Mockup and option: @docs/mockups/AUG-173/transcription-settings.html (Option A). Research: AUG-173. No platform-specific code. Roadmap: M1 Quick fixes.

## ✅ Итог (2026-11-04)
**Что сделано:**
- Две настройки groqLiveCorrection / groqLiveActionItems (default true, отсутствие = true) — живые правки строк и живые action items включаются отдельно, только при активном согласии Groq.
- Settings → Transcription: мастер «Online text (Groq)» + два вложенных чекбокса «Fix live lines» / «Collect live action items» (Option A); при выключенном мастере дети disabled и хранят значения; оба выкл → warn «Live features off…».
- ActionItemsPanel различает «Groq off» и «items off» (основное окно, Dock Strip, Ghost Caption); compact: «Live items off — only manual items».
- Старые пользователи — то же поведение без миграции; consent-флоу и пост-обработка не тронуты.
**Как:** liveGroqTextFeatures() в groqText.ts → {active, correction, actionItems}; каждый ребёнок = active && pref !== false, так что согласие обойти нельзя. Кадр action-items: enabled = решение по items, новое поле groqText = согласие активно; клиент выводит offReason ('groq'|'items') и прокидывает через compactStore/ghostProtocol. Сервер пишет при старте лайва `[live] Groq text: line fixes on|off, action items on|off`. Отклонено: смешанный тип enabled (boolean|'items-off') — неявно.
**Файлы:** @server/src/services/groqText.ts, @server/src/services/liveTranscription.ts, @server/src/routes/preferences.ts, @client/src/services/preferences.ts, @client/src/components/SettingsModal.tsx, @client/src/components/ActionItemsPanel.tsx, @client/src/components/FileUpload.tsx, compact/* (CompactLayer, DockWidgets, GhostApp, ghostProtocol), @client/src/services/compactStore.ts, @client/src/App.css (.settings-child). Миграций нет.
**PR / коммиты:** master ab81e2c (без PR).
**Грабли:** нет. Сервер-билд + 636 тестов зелёные, клиент-билд ок; ручная проверка всех комбинаций на живой записи — пользователь, 2026-11-04, ок.
**Хвосты:** клиентских тестов нет (скрипта нет); полный `npm run build` (version:sync + electron) не гонялся.
